input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: Section 9 is TrueLink's only warranty and covers nothing but Year 2000 date handling; there is no warranty that the Hosting/Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, no conformance-to-documentation warranty for the Interface or related software, no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty, and no repair/replace/refund remedy (Section 3's response-time provision is only a reasonable-efforts covenant). Meanwhile Section 12 (p0076) disclaims all implied warranties, so we are left effectively without any performance warranty. The disclaimer's "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT" carve-out preserves an express warranty, so the minimal fix is to insert the missing warranty and remedy into Section 9.

proposal.summary: Add TrueLink performance/conformance warranty with repair-replace-refund remedy in Section 9
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only a Year 2000 warranty, so TrueLink stands behind neither the Interface nor the Hosting and Support Services. We have added our standard performance warranty: professional and workmanlike services, 12-month conformance to documentation for the software, 90 days for services, compliance with laws and no malicious code, with re-performance, repair/replacement or refund as our remedy. We can accept 90 days (software) / 30 days (services) with the same remedies if duration is the issue.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that: (a) the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (b) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to the applicable specifications and documentation provided by TrueLink, and for a period of ninety (90) days following performance the Hosting Services and Support Services will conform in all material respects to the requirements of this Agreement; (c) the Interface and all related software will be free from viruses, worms, Trojan horses and any other malicious code; and (d) TrueLink will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement. Client's remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties is, at TrueLink's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Hosting Services, Support Services, Interface or related software.
